environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has three listener rules applied in priority order: (1) AWS WAFv2 WebACL association with rule group 'production-api-acl' containing a custom rule using RegexPatternSet that matches request query strings against pattern `(?i)(union|;|--|sleep|benchmark|0x[0-9a-f]+|extractvalue|updatexml)` with action BLOCK and a separate size constraint rule blocking any single query parameter value exceeding 128 bytes; (2) ALB listener rule that strips and overwrites X-Internal-Auth header using a fixed-response action for requests missing a valid mTLS client certificate (achieved via ALB mutual TLS with truststore ARN); (3) Target group health check on /health path only. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network-level access to the RDS instance metadata or other tasks.

alb_mtls.header_injection_protection: ALB strips X-Internal-Auth from external requests without valid client cert

config.networking: awsvpc mode, security group allows inbound only from ALB SG
